title: 生成 $n \times n$ 螺旋矩阵
description: 把 $1, 2, \dots, n^2$ 按顺时针螺旋（从左上角出发向右）填入一个 $n \times n$ 的方阵，输出这个方阵（每行 $n$ 个整数，用空格隔开）。
hint: 用四个边界 $r_1, r_2, c_1, c_2$ 框住还没填的区域，按「右、下、左、上」的顺序各填一条边后收缩边界，直到填满。

solutions.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n0 = int(data[0])
n = n0
g = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
t = 0
r1, r2, c1, c2 = 0, n - 1, 0, n - 1
while r1 <= r2 and c1 <= c2:
    for j in range(c1, c2 + 1):
        t += 1
        g[r1][j] = t
    r1 += 1
    for i in range(r1, r2 + 1):
        t += 1
        g[i][c2] = t
    c2 -= 1
    if r1 <= r2:
        for j in range(c2, c1 - 1, -1):
            t += 1
            g[r2][j] = t
        r2 -= 1
    if c1 <= c2:
        for i in range(r2, r1 - 1, -1):
            t += 1
            g[i][c1] = t
        c1 += 1
print("\n".join(" ".join(map(str, row)) for row in g))
